extDescription.message: Click to remove ads, pop-ups, banners and any other annoying element from a web page. Undo, parent selection, optional memory.

cmdUndo.message: Undo the last removal on the page

pickerHint.message: Click: remove · Shift+click: remove more · ↑/↓: parent/child · Ctrl+Z: undo · Esc: exit

welcomeText.message: Pin the skull icon to your toolbar, open any page and click the icon (or press the shortcut below). Then click the element you want gone.

keyArrows.message: Select the parent / back to the child element

reloadNote.message: Removed elements come back when the page reloads — unless Grudge mode is on.

shortcutsFirefox.message: Firefox: open about:addons, click the gear icon and choose “Manage Extension Shortcuts”.

grudgeText.message: SkullClick remembers every element you remove and hides it automatically on your next visits to the same page.

grudgePrivacy.message: Needs access to all websites so it can run on page load. The list is stored only in this browser and is never sent anywhere.

permissionMissing.message: Grudge mode is on, but SkullClick has no access to websites, so it can't hide anything.

permissionDenied.message: Access was not granted, Grudge mode stays off.

hitListEmpty.message: Nothing here yet. Turn on Grudge mode and remove something.

ruleDeleted.message: Rule deleted. Reload the page to see the element again.

importFailed.message: This file is not a SkullClick hit list.

basedOn.message: Based on ekill by René Hansen.
